subject: Eval continuity request — temporary voucher while PO clears
messages:
From: Alex Ren <alex@novamed.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-08T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Eval continuity during PO clearance

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week — the clinical team at NovaMed is excited to keep evaluating Redwood, but we hit a snag on our side. Procurement has our PO in review and they told us it might take 10–14 business days to get final signatures due to an internal finance audit.

We have a critical show-and-tell with hospital ops on Oct 20 and would lose momentum if the sandbox access lapses next week. Is there any way Redwood can provide a short-term voucher or credits so we can continue testing while procurement finishes the PO? We expect the PO to land (PO #2345) within two weeks.

I attached the draft PO for reference (Novamed_PO_2345.pdf).

Appreciate any flexibility — happy to share the procurement contact if you need to coordinate.

Best,
Alex
Alex Ren
Head of Product, NovaMed
alex@novamed.com

---
Attachment: Novamed_PO_2345.pdf (PDF, 220KB)

From: chloe_martin@redwood.ai

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-08T17:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Eval continuity during PO clearance

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up and for sending the draft PO.

Totally understand the timing risk — we don’t want you to lose momentum ahead of Oct 20. I can escalate and request an interim voucher while procurement completes the review. To set expectations up front: we typically issue time-limited sandbox vouchers tied to the incoming PO number and require the PO to be submitted within the voucher window.

Can you confirm the expected PO approver (name/email) and whether the billing address on the draft is final? I asked Ben (Sales) and Marissa (Sales Ops) to weigh in so we can finalize quickly.

If you can confirm, I’ll ask Ben (Sales) and Marissa (Sales Ops) to prepare a voucher for 14 days of access (we can size credits conservatively and increase if needed after the PO arrives).

Cheers,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.ai
